scope: All fifty-five unresolved private-nonprofit institutions in the alphabetical N, O, and P segments
safeguards: Only official institution-owned employee pages, institution-specific ATS tenants, or direct faculty vacancy pages were promoted.
Student and alumni career services, external ministry boards, and unrelated affiliated employers were rejected.
Merged identities, closing institutions, and pages without a durable employee vacancy index remained unresolved.
Live production probes removed navigation labels, category headings, applications, benefits links, and no-openings prose from published jobs.
